mapping_defect._doc: P6-6A plan 表格行 9 写 'C-17 019 psychro/saturation_water_content 强公式 0.1%', 但 XLS-PR-019 = Natural Gas Saturated Water Content（Behr correlation for natural gas with CO2+H2S），而 PCS service calc_saturation_water_content = Humid Air Saturation Water Content（CoolProp HAPropsSI based on ASHRAE RP-1845）。**Different working fluids**（hydrocarbon mixture vs ~79% N2+21% O2+trace）+ different algorithm families (Behr natural gas vs ASHRAE humid air) → values agree within ~10-30% but NOT bit-for-bit identical. 强公式 0.1% 容差 NOT used；only unit conversions (pure algebra) + OoM cross-validation (within 2 orders of magnitude) registered per Ruling 9.
mapping_defect.xls_scope: XLS-PR-019: Natural gas (hydrocarbon mixture with CO2+H2S) saturated water content via Behr correlation, output units lb/MMscf wet gas + mg/Sm³ wet gas (Worley proprietary coefficients)
mapping_defect.pcs_scope: PCS service calc_saturation_water_content: humid air (~79% N2 + 21% O2 + trace gases) saturation humidity ratio via CoolProp HAPropsSI based on ASHRAE RP-1845, output 3 units (kg/kg dry air / mg/Sm³ dry air / lb/MMscf dry air)
mapping_defect.implication: XLS F29/I29/J29 (lb/MMscf wet gas) ≠ PCS service.saturation_w_lb_per_mmscf (lb/MMscf dry air) bit-for-bit. Working fluid difference (natural gas vs humid air) + algorithm family difference (Behr vs HAPropsSI) makes bit-for-bit comparison meaningless. Test scope reduced to: (1) unit conversions EXACT (algebraic, no algorithm involved); (2) OoM cross-validation (within 2 OoM, accept ~10-30% typical variance); (3) sanity assertions (no NaN, valid struct, all within T/P range, no acid correction since all <40 mol%); (4) Ruling 9 registration. Bit-for-bit value match + Behr correlation coefficients + acid gas correction accuracy (XLS Behr vs PCS ISO 18453) all out_of_scope.

tolerance_policy.per_case_note: 本批因 Ruling 9 working fluid defect（XLS Behr natural gas vs PCS CoolProp humid air）— 不同工质 + 不同算法族，bit-for-bit 对账无意义。强公式 0.1% 容差 NOT used for direct value match; 仅 unit conversion 用 rel=1e-12 严格一致（pure algebra, no algorithm）。OoM cross-validation 用 2 OoM band (0.01 < ratio < 100) 替代强公式，作为 working fluid defect 兜底。

unit_conversion_factors._doc: Worley XLS PR-019 输入/输出单位混合制：Imperial（°F/psia/lb/MMscf）+ SI（°C/Bar/mg/Sm³）。PCS service 全 SI 输入（°C/kPa）+ 三独立输出单位（kg/kg / mg/Sm³ / lb/MMscf）。需 5 步单位转换链：°F→°C ((T-32)×5/9)；psia→kPa (×6.894757)；bar→kPa (×100)；lb/MMscf↔mg/Sm³ (×16.01846 / ÷16.01846)。

root_cause_notes.finding: P6-6A plan 表格行 9 'C-17 019 psychro/saturation_water_content 强公式 0.1%' 与 XLS-PR-019 物理范围错配。XLS-PR-019 Calculation sheet 是 Natural Gas Saturated Water Content (Behr correlation for natural gas with CO2+H2S, output lb/MMscf wet gas + mg/Sm³ wet gas); PCS service calc_saturation_water_content 是 Humid Air Saturation Water Content (CoolProp HAPropsSI based on ASHRAE RP-1845, output 3 units: kg/kg / mg/Sm³ / lb/MMscf dry air)。**Different working fluids** (hydrocarbon mixture vs ~79% N2 + 21% O2 + trace) + **different algorithm families** (Behr proprietary vs HAPropsSI ASHRAE RP-1845) → values agree within ~10-30% typical variance but NOT bit-for-bit identical. 强公式 0.1% 容差 NOT used; 改用 unit conversion EXACT (algebraic) + OoM cross-validation (2 OoM band) 替代 bit-for-bit value match。对账范围: ①3 步 unit conversion EXACT (°F→°C / psia→kPa / bar→kPa / lb/MMscf↔mg/Sm³) ②OoM cross-validation within 2 OoM ③sanity assertions (no NaN, valid struct, all in T/P range, no acid correction since all <40 mol%) ④Ruling 9 三层注册。Bit-for-bit value match + Behr correlation coefficients + acid gas correction accuracy (XLS Behr vs PCS ISO 18453) + wet gas vs dry gas semantics + Imperial/SI output 双套 + T/P limit check (XLS D33-F35 vs service _T_MIN_C/_T_MAX_C/_P_MAX_PA) + Conversion data block (rows 62-113) + Notes block (rows 38-40) 9 项全 out_of_scope。
root_cause_notes.ruling: Ruling 9 working fluid defect (Ruling 9)——XLS natural gas (Behr) vs PCS humid air (CoolProp HAPropsSI) 是 different working fluids + different algorithm families。强公式 0.1% 容差不适用; 对账范围收窄至 unit conversion EXACT (algebraic) + OoM cross-validation (2 OoM band) + sanity assertions; bit-for-bit value match + Behr correlation + acid gas correction accuracy 9 项全 out_of_scope。批 B 立项评估: (a) 落地 Behr natural gas water content 作为 PCS 新 service (calc_behr_natural_gas_water_content) 以覆盖 XLS-PR-019 物理范围; 或 (b) 维持现状仅 SPEC V1.2 注明 working fluid 差异 + 双算法族并存。

root_cause_notes.finding: XLS F29/J29 单位标签 'lb/MMscf wet gas' / 'mg/Sm³ wet gas' 是 wet gas（含水蒸气）基准；PCS service.saturation_w_lb_per_mmscf 是 dry air（不含水蒸气）基准。语义差 + working fluid 差双重叠加。注：XLS 在 Behr 公式内部应已做 wet/dry 修正（XLS 隐式使用），但 XLS 单位标签 wet gas 强调 wet/dry 是分母差异的提醒。PCS service 严格输出 dry air (kg 水 / kg 干空气)。
root_cause_notes.ruling: Ruling 9 working fluid defect 的子集——XLS 显式 wet gas 分母 vs PCS 隐式 dry air 分母，加剧 bit-for-bit value match 不可行。登记防 fixture 演进时静默丢失；OUT_OF_SCOPE 注册。

root_cause_notes.finding: XLS Case F-I 用 Imperial psia (F18-I18), Case J 用 SI bar (J18) per XLS J14='SI' unit selection. 但 XLS J17 温度仍是 °F (Imperial), 仅 P 切换 SI. 这是 XLS Calculation sheet 内部 hybrid Imperial/SI 双单位 convention. PCS service 全 SI 输入 (T_c, P_kpa), Case J 转换链: J17 °F → (J17-32)×5/9 °C + J18 bar → ×100 kPa.
root_cause_notes.ruling: Ruling 1(b) 接口口径——XLS 双单位 convention 与 PCS 全 SI 差异, 非代码缺陷. 本 fixture Case J 用 XLS 转换链: T=21.7283°C, P=6996.083 kPa. 登记防 fixture 演进时漂移.
